why: text with no brace is returned untouched — the rule does not reach the ordinary path
a run of two closing braces inside the content is separated
a run at the very start is separated too
a run of four is separated in one pass
content ending in a single brace is padded, so the boundary with the closing `}}` does not form a third consecutive brace
a bare closing brace is padded
LaTeX: separated, then padded, because separation leaves a trailing brace behind
an opening brace run is not a hazard — Anki's pattern closes on `}}`, not on `{{`
a hand-written marker would be DESTROYED by this rule, which is why REQ-ML-006.1 declines to wrap a span already carrying one
